Feature: Doctor Consultation and Prescription Management

  Scenario: Doctor views pending appointments and provides consultation
    Given the doctor has 3 pending appointments in the list
    When the doctor views the pending appointments
    Then the doctor sees the list of 3 pending appointments
    And the doctor selects the first appointment
    When the doctor provides consultation for the selected appointment
    Then the consultation is successfully recorded with consultation ID C001

  Scenario Outline: Doctor provides consultation and generates prescription
    Given the doctor has provided consultation for appointment with ID <appointment_id>
    When the doctor prescribes <medicine_name> with dosage <dosage>
    Then the prescription is generated with prescription ID <prescription_id>
    And the prescription includes <medicine_name> with dosage <dosage>

    Examples:
      | appointment_id | medicine_name | dosage | prescription_id |
      | A001           | Paracetamol   | 500mg  | P001            |
      | A002           | Aspirin       | 300mg  | P002            |
      | A003           | Invalid Medicine | 200mg | P003            | # Invalid case

  Scenario Outline: Doctor prescribes lab tests during consultation
    Given the doctor has provided consultation for appointment with ID <appointment_id>
    When the doctor prescribes <lab_test_name>
    Then the lab test is created with lab test ID <lab_test_id>
    And the lab is requested to perform the lab test

    Examples:
      | appointment_id | lab_test_name | lab_test_id |
      | A001           | Blood Test    | L001        |
      | A002           | Urine Test    | L002        |
      | A003           | Invalid Test  | L003        | # Invalid case

  Scenario: Doctor requests lab test to be performed
    Given the doctor has prescribed a lab test with ID L001
    When the doctor requests the lab to perform the lab test
    Then the lab test request is successfully sent with request ID R001

  Scenario: Doctor prescribes medicines during consultation
    Given the doctor has provided consultation for appointment with ID A001
    When the doctor prescribes Paracetamol with dosage 500mg
    Then the medicine prescription is generated with prescription ID P001
    And the concerned chemist is requested to deliver Paracetamol with dosage 500mg

  Scenario: Doctor requests medicine delivery
    Given the doctor has prescribed Paracetamol with dosage 500mg
    When the doctor requests the chemist to deliver Paracetamol
    Then the medicine delivery request is successfully sent with request ID R002

  Scenario: Lab test is performed and report is updated (Offline)
    Given the lab has performed the lab test with ID L001
    When the lab updates the report for the patient
    Then the lab report is updated with report ID RP001

  Scenario: Lab report is released to view (Offline)
    Given the lab report with ID RP001 is updated
    When the doctor releases the lab report to the patient
    Then the lab report is released with status code 200

  Scenario: Doctor views no pending appointments
    Given the doctor has no pending appointments in the list
    When the doctor views the pending appointments
    Then the doctor sees an empty list with message "No pending appointments"

  Scenario: Prescription generation failure
    Given the doctor has provided consultation for appointment with ID A003
    When the doctor prescribes Invalid Medicine with dosage 200mg
    Then the prescription generation fails with error code 400
